title: Sync reauth schedulers and async iterator idioms across Python/TypeScript/Go SDKs
author: Priya Desai
description: Motivation: Different SDKs had divergent reauth scheduling semantics and async-iterator ergonomics which made cross-language examples and client libraries inconsistent, increasing onboarding friction and causing subtle race conditions in session refresh. This PR unifies the external API shape and internal scheduler contract for reauth/heartbeat across the Python, TypeScript, and Go SDKs, and applies small ergonomic tweaks to async generator/iterator surfaces so examples behave the same across languages. Changes include a lightweight scheduler abstraction, clearer backoff presets, deterministic heartbeat ordering, and small adapter layers to preserve backwards compatibility in each SDK. Checklist: - [x] Design doc linked (ENG-2142) - [x] Implement scheduler abstraction in each SDK - [x] Add adapter shims for legacy consumers - [x] Update unit + integration tests - [x] Bump SDK minor versions where necessary - [x] Add migration notes and docs (docs/sdk/async_iterators.md) Impact: No breaking API changes for majority of consumers; some advanced users with custom scheduler implementations must migrate to the new hook (migration steps included in release notes).

Priya Desai (author): Added jitter and a deterministic seed for the flaky CI run; re-ran CI. See commit d2e0f55 and f4b223c.
Derek Wong (approver): Verified that docs examples produce identical behavior locally for py/ts/go. Approving after minor doc tweaks.

release_notes:
- SDKs: unified reauth scheduler interface across Python/TS/Go.
- SDKs: async iterator helpers standardized, expect more consistent examples across languages.
- Minor version bumps: Python 0.13.0, TypeScript 1.9.0, Go 0.8.1.
- Migration: users with custom scheduler implementations should follow docs/migration/reauth-scheduler-migration.md for adaptation steps.
notes_for_backport: Candidate for backport to release/1.9.x (TS) and release/0.13.x (Py) if customers run custom schedulers. Backport will include adapter shims only.
